Subject: NovoCorp GCP private offer — billing onramp & execution MAP

Hi Greg / Alice,

Following our call earlier: attaching an initial execution MAP for the GCP private offer and the proposed billing onramp. High level ask: confirm procurement path and PO owner so we can lock the private offer window in the marketplace. Quick summary below — full details in novocorp_map_v1.xlsx attached.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): Sign mutual MAP and confirm PO owner.
- Week 1-2: Legal review / DocuSign of private offer paper, provide PO.
- Week 2-4: Marketplace private-offer activation + test billing cycle.
- Week 4-6: Two-week evaluation (performance + cost) on committed capacity.

Billing path options we discussed:
1) Marketplace billing (monthly invoices through GCP Marketplace) — simplest for internal finance but requires PO referencing private offer id.
2) Direct invoice with Redwood (monthly) — can be set up if your procurement needs a single vendor invoice.

Please confirm which billing path your team prefers and who owns the PO/legal routing. If we get these confirmed by next Wed (2028-09-06) we can keep the private offer window open and hit a mid-September activation.

Attachments: novocorp_map_v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet), pricing_breakdown_2028Q3.csv

Thanks — Vivek

Subject: Re: NovoCorp GCP private offer — billing onramp & execution MAP

Greg — quick answers inline and an updated checklist attached.

On billing path: we recommend Marketplace billing as the default for private offers. Benefits:
- Automatic invoicing through GCP (no vendor setup delay).
- PO can reference the private offer ID we generate; finance closes through existing Marketplace processes.

If your AP requires a Redwood invoice instead, we can do that but will need vendor onboarding (2-3 business days) and a primary Redwood AP contact: ap@redwood.com (Accounts Payable) — phone (415) 555-0102.

PO language (suggested):
- NovoCorp Purchase Order referencing Redwood Inference private offer ID PO-REDW-NOVO-232. Term: 12 months commitment; billing monthly via GCP Marketplace unless otherwise specified.

Attached: novocorp_map_v1.xlsx (updated with milestone owners), pricing_breakdown_2028Q3.csv, po_checklist.pdf

Proposed short timeline (conservative):
- 9/6: Confirm billing path + PO owner
- 9/8: Procurement sends PO or template / legal to review
- 9/11: DocuSign order form executed
- 9/13: Private offer created in GCP Marketplace, test invoice run 9/20
- 9/20-10/04: 2-week evaluation on committed capacity (performance + cost)

Let us know if we should compress/expand any dates. If Procurement needs a specific contact for the Marketplace creation step, that's Aditya (aditya@redwood.com).

Thanks,
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

Laura / Vivek — procurement here. We reviewed the MAP and have two items before we can issue a PO:

1) Contract redlines: sending our redline to the Order Form and a summary of required language changes (attached: novocorp_redline.docx). Please respond with acceptance or counter redlines.
2) Security evidence: we need a SOC 2 package and any data handling diagrams for the private deployment. Please provide SOC2 evidence and a completed security questionnaire (we attached soc2_request_form.pdf).

Other notes:
- AP prefers Marketplace billing but requires the private-offer id listed on the PO.
- Please confirm Redwood's remit-to address and vendor tax ID for vendor onboarding if we end up on direct invoicing.

Procurement Team

Subject: Re: NovoCorp GCP private offer — billing onramp & execution MAP

Procurement / Greg — thanks for the clear items. Quick status and next steps: 

- Redlines: we reviewed novocorp_redline.docx and accept the majority of the edits. Legal proposes one small counter on data retention (clause 6.2) — we'll highlight and return an updated Order Form by EOD Wed 2028-09-18.
- SOC2 / security evidence: attached soc2_evidence_pack.pdf and a short architecture diagram in the shared Drive link (see related links). Aditya will coordinate a brief 30-min security walk-through if needed.
- PO language: confirmed — use private-offer id PO-REDW-NOVO-232 and list billing via GCP Marketplace unless AP requests Redwood invoice.

Evaluation plan (updated, runs after activation):
- 9/13: Private offer activation (pending signed Order Form)
- 9/13-9/20: Smoke tests and initial traffic (low concurrency)
- 9/20-10/04: Controlled evaluation window (key checkpoints):
  * Week 1 checkpoint (9/23): latency & throughput baseline vs target
  * Week 2 checkpoint (9/30): cost per 1k tokens vs forecast, prefix cache hit rate
  * 10/04: close decision (continue with commitment or adjust configuration)

Next immediate asks from Redwood:
- Procurement: confirm whether you will issue a PO referencing PO-REDW-NOVO-232 by 9/08 or if we should expect vendor onboarding instead.
- Greg / Alice: confirm whether Marketplace billing is OK — that will avoid vendor onboarding delays.

Attachments: novocorp_redline.docx (redline returned), soc2_evidence_pack.pdf

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet in Drive after we finalize the Order Form.

Best — Vivek
